field.name: thruDateSetAuto
field.description: If Y then expire (set thruDate) once allowed (no active Payment)

field.name: titleOnAccount
field.description: Not commonly used; payment gateways generally only separate first and last names

field.name: middleNameOnAccount
field.description: Not commonly used; payment gateways generally only separate first and last names; for credit cards middle initial generally included with first name

field.name: suffixOnAccount
field.description: Not commonly used; payment gateways generally only separate first and last names

field.name: loanPaymentPeriodUomId
field.description: Uom with uomTypeEnumId=UT_TIME_FREQ_MEASURE

field.name: imageUrl
field.description: Usually specific to a type or sub-type of PaymentMethod, for display to users

field.name: paymentFraudEvidenceId
field.description: Refer to evidence here if trust level is gray listed or black listed

field.name: glAccountId
field.description: A GL Account associated with this PaymentMethod for reconciliation, etc

field.name: finAccountId
field.description: Refers to FinancialAccount when paymentMethodTypeEnumId=PmtFinancialAccount

field.name: originalPaymentMethodId
field.description: Because PaymentMethod records are treated as immutable (except for certain fields) they are cloned and expired on update and this field will have the paymentMethodId of the original record.

entity.description: Transactions of the PaymentMethod, such as imported from an OFX file (see www.ofx.net); can be imported from any source and reconciled in a more consistent way from here

field.name: fitId
field.description: Financial Institution Transaction ID (OFX STMTTRN.FITID)

field.name: transType
field.description: Transaction type (OFX STMTTRN.TRNTYPE), either literal value or enumId with enumTypeId PaymentMethodTransType

field.name: transCode
field.description: The original transaction type code, will be same as transType unless enumId used for transType

field.name: postedDate
field.description: Date posted (OFX STMTTRN.DTPOSTED)

field.name: transAmount
field.description: Transaction amount (OFX STMTTRN.TRNAMT)

field.name: transName
field.description: Transaction name (OFX STMTTRN.NAME or PAYEE; as per spec only one may be used)

field.name: transMemo
field.description: Transaction memo (OFX STMTTRN.MEMO)

field.name: checkNumber
field.description: Check number, rarely included but very useful for reconciliation (OFX STMTTRN.CHECKNUM)

field.name: refNumber
field.description: Reference number (OFX STMTTRN.REFNUM)

field.name: noReconcile
field.description: If Y this transaction is not to be reconciled, represents multiple payments or otherwise

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: Point of sale debit or credit

field.name: accountNumber
field.description: Encrypted from Nov 16, 2026; a number stored before then is encrypted by migrate#BankAccountNumbers. Never searched by value.

field.name: nachaImmedDest
field.description: Must be 9 digits, generally assigned by bank, usually bank routing/transit number

field.name: nachaImmedOrig
field.description: Must be 9 digits, generally assigned by bank, ID identifying company as source/origin for NACHA files

field.name: nachaImmedDestName
field.description: Defaults to bankName, upper-cased; must not be more than 23 characters

field.name: nachaImmedOrigName
field.description: Defaults to companyNameOnAccount, upper-cased; must not be more than 23 characters

field.name: nachaCompanyName
field.description: Used to identify company in ACH transactions. Defaults to companyNameOnAccount, upper-cased; must not be more than 16 characters for NACHA files

field.name: nachaDiscrData
field.description: Discretionary data, may be sub account or other; must not be more than 20 characters

field.name: nachaCompanyId
field.description: Bank-assigned Company ID for ACH transactions; must not be more than 10 characters

field.name: nachaOdfiId
field.description: Batch ODFI ID (Originating Depository Financial Institution), 8 digits, defaults to first 8 digits of nachaImmedDest (Immediate Destination ID)

field.name: nachaEntryDescription
field.description: A description to be added to ACH transactions (such as Payroll, Order); must not be more than 10 characters

field.name: posPayBankNumber
field.description: Number specified by bank to identify bank in positive pay files

entity.description: A simple check register (for Checking type BankAccount) with details on the Payment entity

field.name: cardNumberLookupHash
field.description: A one-way hash (SHA, etc) of the cardNumber used for looking up a credit card by its number in a secure way.

field.name: validFromDate
field.description: Not common but used in some parts of the world

field.name: expireDate
field.description: String representing the date in the format: MM/yyyy

field.name: issueNumber
field.description: Single digit number on some Switch and Maestro cards

field.name: cardSecurityCode
field.description: CVV/etc number for card. By PCI rules can only be recorded until authorization is complete, after that must be deleted. Set the mantle.account.PaymentServices.authorize#SinglePayment service for where this is done.

entity.description: For externally managed gift cards (not locally managed in a FinancialAccount)

field.name: paymentGatewayTypeEnumId
field.description: Each payment gateway integration should define a PaymentGatewayType Enumeration record plus an entity with a shared PK (ie PK is paymentGatewayConfigId).

field.name: authorizeServiceName
field.description: Service implementing the mantle.account.PaymentServices.authorize#Payment interface

field.name: captureServiceName
field.description: Service implementing the mantle.account.PaymentServices.capture#Payment interface

field.name: releaseServiceName
field.description: Service implementing the mantle.account.PaymentServices.release#Payment interface

field.name: refundServiceName
field.description: Service implementing the mantle.account.PaymentServices.refund#Payment interface

field.name: detailsServiceName
field.description: Service implementing the mantle.account.PaymentServices.get#PaymentGatewayDetails interface

entity.description: Organization gateway bindings provisioned outside finance forms. Finance administrators may bind methods only to these active gateways; credentials and executable configuration remain in Admin.

One statement file read for a bank account: review#StatementImport parses it and classifies each row as new, a duplicate of a line already imported (by its identity, the bank's FIT id or the source-row key) or rejected, and commit#StatementImport creates the new lines. The rows are kept as the user reviewed them, with what commit did to each.

field.name: warningsJson
field.description: File-level warnings, such as a BAI2 control total that does not match the rows read

entity.description: A bank statement session: one statement of one bank account for its period, with the statement's opening and closing balances. The lines it clears are BankReconciliationLine rows over the bank lines of the period; finish#Reconciliation completes it only when every line of the period is cleared and the opening balance and the cleared lines add up to the closing balance. Sessions of one bank never overlap.

field.name: clearedInflow
field.description: At finish: the positive cleared lines

field.name: clearedOutflow
field.description: At finish: the negative cleared lines, as a positive amount

entity.description: A bank line a statement session cleared. The key is the bank line, so one line is cleared by one session only: a second session's clear is refused by the key, however the two requests interleave.

A rule that suggests the counterparty of a bank line from its text: a line whose name, memo or reference contains the match text, in the rule's direction and amount range, is suggested the payments of the rule's party for the same amount. A rule with autoApply reconciles a line only when it is the one rule matching the line and finds exactly one payment; otherwise it only suggests. An ended rule (thruDate) stays for the audit.

field.name: paymentMethodId
field.description: Only lines of this bank account; empty for every bank account of the organization

field.name: sequenceNum
field.description: The priority: a lower number first

entity.description: The non-secret options of an Authorize.Net gateway (PaymentGatewayConfig with paymentGatewayTypeEnumId PgtAuthorizeNet, shared key). The connection is the config's SystemMessageRemote: sendUrl the API endpoint (https://apitest.authorize.net/xml/v1/request.api for the sandbox, https://api.authorize.net/xml/v1/request.api for production), usageCode T or P, username the API login id, password the transaction key, sharedSecret the webhook signature key (messageAuthEnumId SmatHmacSha512, authHeaderName X-ANET-Signature). Ported from the AuthorizeDotNet component's PaymentGatewayAuthorizeNet, whose login and transaction key move to the remote's encrypted fields.

field.name: publicClientKey
field.description: The public client key for Accept.js (Account, Settings, Manage Public Client Key). Public: the browser gets it with the API login id.

field.name: validationMode
field.description: For a new customer payment profile: none (the default), testMode or liveMode (a zero or small authorization that validates the card).

field.name: duplicateWindow
field.description: Seconds for the provider's duplicate transaction check (transactionSettings duplicateWindow); empty for the provider's default. Not Mantle's idempotency: a retry after a lost answer is looked up by its reference first.

field.name: lookupGraceSeconds
field.description: How old a lost answer must be before a lookup that finds no transaction for its reference answers that the provider has none (not done); a younger one stays unknown, as the provider may still be processing it. Empty is 300; it is always at least duplicateWindow plus 60, as a resend inside the duplicate window would be refused.

entity.description: The non-secret options of a PayTrace gateway (PaymentGatewayConfig with paymentGatewayTypeEnumId PgtPayTrace, shared key), on the PayTrace JSON API v3. The connection is the config's SystemMessageRemote: sendUrl the API base (https://api.sandbox.paytrace.com for the sandbox, https://api.paytrace.com for production), usageCode T or P (it picks the Protect.js host), username the API user (OAuth client_id) and password its password (client_secret), in the remote's encrypted fields. Ported from the mantle-paytrace component's PaymentGatewayPayTrace, whose login moves to the remote and whose hostName and apiVersion are replaced by the remote's endpoint and the v3 paths.

field.name: merchantId
field.description: The PayTrace merchant account id (merchant_id, a number) every transaction request names.

field.name: integratorId
field.description: The integrator id PayTrace issued for this integration (X-Integrator-Id, up to 12 characters), sent with every request. It identifies the integration, not the account, and is not a credential.

field.name: currencyUomId
field.description: The currency of the merchant account. PayTrace amounts carry no currency, so a payment in another currency is refused (CURRENCY_NOT_SUPPORTED) rather than sent.

field.name: lookupGraceSeconds
field.description: How old a lost answer must be before a lookup that finds no transaction for its reference answers that the provider has none (not done); a younger one stays unknown, as PayTrace's export may lag. Empty is 300.

field.name: sendEnhancedData
field.description: N to send no level 2/3 enhanced data; empty or Y sends it after each capture or sale of a payment with an order or invoice.

field.name: commodityCode
field.description: The level 3 commodity code of a line whose product has none (ProductIdentification PidtCommodityCode): the code the merchant service provider assigned, 3 to 20 letters, digits or dashes.

field.name: defaultUnitOfMeasure
field.description: The level 3 unit of measure of a line with no quantity unit, or one with no PayTrace code (1 to 12 letters or digits, such as PCE or EA).

field.name: customerLabelPrefix
field.description: Put before the vault customer label ("mantle-" and the payment method id), for instances sharing one PayTrace account (their method ids can repeat).

entity.description: A payment gateway connection's OAuth access token (PayTrace's client-credentials token), kept between requests until shortly before it expires. The token is in an encrypted field, under the instance's key, never in a cache entry and never sealed with a key derived from the remote's password, so whoever reads the cache or this row's stored bytes cannot test password guesses offline (SEC-BAP-136).

field.name: accessTokenKey
field.description: A hash of the connection (remote, endpoint and API user), never of a secret.

field.name: expiresAt
field.description: When the token expires, in milliseconds.
